purpose: Numerical experimental ownership is Cellerator from inception, not only after promotion.

links.contract: Thin experimental provider: typed dimensions/axis meaning, explicit weights/state, caller-owned buffers/stream/scratch, precision and source-independent operator semantics. Baseplane supplies sequence-derived inputs and maps outputs back to source.
links.activation: Provider and consumer remain separate local tasks. Bind foreign evidence through the installed supported coordination mechanism; never insert foreign IDs into a local depends_on. No wait for global production ABI or completion of all ML2.
links.fallback: A Baseplane scalar oracle/fixture may unblock sequence design. It is not a duplicate numerical backend or proof the Cellerator provider is delivered.
